pass.answer: Rerun check in a fresh session: a same-session check still reports the old value. Report the effective value it observes.
Open a new session and run check; the running session keeps the old value, so only the new check's observed value counts.
To tell it worked, run /desktop-notification:setup check in a fresh session and read the value it reports; the same session shows the old one.

fail.answer: Rerun check right here to confirm.
Start a new session; the hook is off then, no need to check.
Read settings.json to confirm the value.
